not_recorded.why: No command wrote this record: it is kept by hand, so there is no stage that produced it, no arguments it was given and no moment it was captured at. The date below is the day it first entered the repository.

identity_decoded.note: The unit reports an all-zero software revision, so the firmware version cannot be read from the Identity Reply. Firmware identification for this unit is unresolved.

rear_selector.note: The DIN MIDI IN does not reach the tone generator in any of the three labelled positions. MIDI OUT still emits Active Sensing in every position, so the failure presents as a healthy receive path with a silent transmit path. The selector is read only at power-on.

measurement_chain.midi_wiring: interface MIDI OUT -> unit MIDI IN 1; unit MIDI OUT 1 -> interface MIDI IN
measurement_chain.audio_wiring: unit OUTPUT 1 L -> interface INPUT 3; R -> INPUT 4 (rear, fixed gain)
measurement_chain.unit_volume: maximum (hard stop, exactly reproducible without markings)
measurement_chain.capture: CoreAudio HAL AudioDeviceCreateIOProcID, 48000 Hz, 6 ch, float32
measurement_chain.capture_note: ffmpeg -f avfoundation silently loses about 11 percent of samples on this path and must not be used.

measurement_health.capture_open_latency_note: Stream open to first block. A stimulus timed from the call to the recorder rather than from the first block sounds before anything is captured, and only its tail is recorded -- at the right length, with no dropouts, and healthy by every other check.
measurement_health.take_repeatability_note: Two takes of one struck note, aligned to a fraction of a sample and levelled, on program 0 with no effect on. 0.4 to 2.3 dB above the floor two takes' noise would leave.
measurement_health.chain_frequency_wander_note: An upper bound, not a reading: every voice measured passed through the same converters, so the chain cannot wander more than the least wobbly of them does.

capabilities_confirmed.oversized_request_behaviour: not uniform: some regions truncate the reply at the region boundary, others refuse entirely and return nothing. A silent reply does not mean the region is absent.

stops_answering_when.asked: all 128 offsets of a 40 4n block, in order, as single-byte reads
stops_answering_when.observed: the block gives up its live offsets and the unit then answers nothing further, including the canary at 40 01 30 that had been answering between regions
stops_answering_when.recovery: a power cycle. While it is silent the interface still enumerates, no other process holds the port, and two identity requests fifteen seconds apart go unanswered, so the silence is the unit's and not the host's.
stops_answering_when.note: Which offset does it is not known, and each attempt to find out costs a power cycle. Sweeping a 40 4n block this way is therefore not run on this unit, and offsets/40-4x.json holds what the first run reached before it went quiet -- a record of a run that stopped, not of a block that ends there.
